why: Every form of Theorem 15.3.7 in A assumes, besides B's hypotheses, (i) the tame-germ hypothesis A.B.IsScFredholmSectionTame f, (ii) bump functions in the pointwise reading (non-zero at the given point; B uses the printed reading, non-zero somewhere), and (iii) for a structurable Λ a good system (Nonempty GoodSystem, e.g. from paracompact |X|); without (iii) A gives an sc⁺-multisection functor only. B asks for a structurable Λ under none of (i)-(iii), so A => B is not available; with (i)-(iii) added (Bplus) it is proved from the conjunct theorem_15_3_7_of_paracompact. B => main conjunct theorem_15_3_7 is proved (and B gives theorem_15_3_7_statement A for every A, hence the conjuncts theorem_15_3_7_existence, _of_goodSystem, _of_paracompact); the remaining ~105 conjuncts are proof steps (GPFamily, seeds, parametric transversality, norm estimates, R^n x R^0 examples) that B does not state.
B_issue: B asserts a structurable Λ with no paracompactness of |X| or good-system hypothesis; in the project structurable (Definition 13.3.6) contains a good system, which the text obtains from paracompact |X| (Theorem 13.1.8), while Remark 15.3.8 says the theorem does not assume paracompactness. B may thus ask more than the text's 'can be taken structurable' gives without a good system.
overlap: B_to_main / B_to_forms: 458 shared project theorems each, all reached through the vocabulary in the types (proof fields of IsInGeneralPosition, linearizations, charts and retractions); the proof itself uses only AdmitsBumpFunctionsPointwise.weak

partial.A_to_Bplus: proved (Bplus = B plus IsScFredholmSectionTame f, AdmitsBumpFunctionsPointwise, HasParacompactOrbitSpace) as projection + paracompact_to_Bplus; paracompact_to_Bplus passes #rt_check, but A_to_Bplus itself cannot pass #rt_check or #rt_check_soft because the statement A contains the banned theorems isSection_paramSec, isSection_negRestrict, isScPlusSection_negRestrict as proof arguments inside other conjuncts' types
partial.B_to_forms: proved: B implies theorem_15_3_7_existence, theorem_15_3_7_of_goodSystem, theorem_15_3_7_of_paracompact
